title: Compactness of a finite real standard simplex
statement: For every integer $n\geq0$, the standard topological simplex $\{(t_0,\ldots,t_n)\in\mathbb R^{n+1}: t_i\geq0,\ \sum_{i=0}^n t_i=1\}$ with its subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology] is compact.
